e.title: DeepSeek
e.summary: 擅长思维链推理与计算，可作精算建模引擎
e.body: DeepSeek 以思维链推理见长，适合逐步推导 [[value-at-risk]]、[[duration]]、[[actuarial-present-value]] 等量化问题。它是 [[rim523]]、[[rim537]]、[[rim531]] 等课程的核心学习工具。
e.body_en: DeepSeek excels at step-by-step (chain-of-thought) reasoning, suited to deriving quantitative problems such as VaR, duration, and actuarial present value.
e.body_hk: DeepSeek 以思維鏈推理見長，適合逐步推導 [[value-at-risk]]、[[duration]]、[[actuarial-present-value]] 等量化問題。它是 [[rim523]]、[[rim537]]、[[rim531]] 等課程的核心學習工具。
e.summary_en: Reasoning model, usable as an actuarial computation engine
e.summary_hk: 擅長思維鏈推理與計算，可作精算建模引擎
